mapper.select: SELECT P.ID AS id , P.TITLE AS title , P.CONTENT AS content , P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt , P.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , M.MEM_NICKNAME AS memNickname , M.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS memProfileImg , M.MEM_ROLE AS memRole , P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS C WHERE C.POST_ID = P.ID) AS commentCount , P.HASHTAGS AS hashtags , P.CATEGORY AS category FROM POSTS P LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO M ON P.MEM_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE P.ID = #{id}
